reviews.review_text:
Mimo M
1 contribution
1
SCAM!! AVOID THIS PLACE!!
Oct 2023 • Couples
This place is a SCAM. they didn’t even let us choose what we wanted and made it seem like there was only one thing on the menu. We ordered one bowl but then they brought out some spring rolls and other small snack platters which made it seem like it came with what we ordered but IT WASNT!! They brought out something that we didn’t even order so that they can scam us. We only ordered one bowl of soup which they charged us 60.000 for and then they tried charging us 40.000 each for the 2 small platters they brought out to us that we didn’t ask for. There was another customer sat behind us eating that spoke English and made us aware of the reviews of this place and how they scam tourists by doing this. So we then refused to pay for the 2 platters as we knew it was a scam they also realised that we knew they were trying to scam us. We only ended up paying 60.000 at the end. So please be aware of this scam technique that they use. 

Overall the food wasn’t even that great. It was very disappointing and the experience wasn’t good either. I only came here because I saw that Mark Weins visited this place and gave the food a good rating. But I guess not everyone’s experiences are the same. If you’re visiting Saigon, just avoid this place and don’t waste your time.

Not cheap, not clean.
Jun 2023 • Friends
This is a very ordinary street restaurant in Ho Chi Minh. 
The restaurant is located on the sidewalk of the internal residential area. 
Personally, the dishes here are also normal, not as special as advertised. Diners do not have enough tables to sit, must be grouped with other guests. This is very inconvenient. 
Moreover, there are no toilets here, tissues are scattered on the roadway, and the restaurant does not have trash cans. 
The service price in my opinion is not cheap if compared with other street restaurants

The most DISGUSTING bowl of soup I ever had in Vietnam
Jan 2020 • Couples
I wish I had read the tripadvisor’s previous reviews prior to venturing out to this place made famous by Anthony Bourdain. Since the lunch lady reached fame she has obviously stopped everything else, including cooking. There was a rat crawling around when we got there. The table was filthy from the previous customer, she didn’t even wipe it. She brought us fried spring rolls served with her fingers and no other condiments. I am
Vietnamese and we eat these spring rolls with lettuce and fish sauce (nuoc mam) and when I asked for them she said she didn’t have any and instead she just squeezed some red sauce on a dirty plate for us. The spring rolls were cold. But we came for the soup so were hoping for the best since we came with high expectations. In the meanwhile she was sitting and drinking beer with her friends while instructing some woman from across the street to bring two bowls of soup. The soup arrived, again, no condiments. The soup was bland, the noodles were dry. It was absolutely tasteless. Cup o noodles is more delicious. I ate a few bites but could not finish it due to the constant thought in the back of mind of that rat crawling around so comfortably. 

We asked for the bill and she took over 30 seconds to think. Two beers, plate of cold spring rolls and two bowls of the most disgusting soup I have ever eaten in Vietnam. She finally came up with a number 360,000 VD. Are you kidding me??!! 

Please don’t ever go there!! Sorry Anthony, I am sure it was good in your time but now, the food and place is an absolute dump. For food safety reasons and for unashamingly ripping off customers this place must be closed down immediately.
